# Related collections are null until $expand asks for them

**Claim.** Emails, phones and addresses come back null — not empty — unless the request names them in $expand. Expanded, a section the person actually has is an array of entries and a section they lack is an empty array, so null always means 'not requested', never 'none'.

Applies to: `~1people~1{vanId}/get`

## Observed exchange

_A person with one email and nothing else._

```http
(setup) POST /people/create

{
  "firstName": "Nadia",
  "lastName": "Okonkwo-{scope}",
  "emails": [
    {
      "email": "nadia.okonkwo-{scope}@example.com"
    }
  ]
}

→ 201
  Location: https://api.securevan.com/v4/people/100000001
{
  "vanId": 100000001,
  "status": "Stored"
}
```

_Without $expand, every collection is null — including the email we just wrote._
